title: Managing windows
summary: Hide, resize, switch and close windows.
learn: Make a window bigger or smaller

steps.say: Click the dash (-) to hide Notepad.
steps.detail: It is not closed. It waits on the bar at the bottom.

steps.say: Click Notepad on the bottom bar to bring it back.
steps.detail: That bottom bar is called the taskbar.

steps.say: Click the square to make Notepad fill the screen.
Click the same square again to make it smaller.
steps.detail: The button works like a switch.

steps.say: Switch windows: hold Alt, tap Tab.
steps.detail: On some computers this key press is caught by Windows itself. If so, use the button below.

steps.say: Click the X to close File Explorer.

steps.detail: Well done. You can now manage your windows.
